data.reasoning: The deepseek model successfully reviewed all package files (PKGBUILD, .SRCINFO, LICENSE) and found no security issues, noting standard Python build tools and a pinned GitHub release source. data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is caused by a tool error in the qwen model (HTTP 400 BadRequestError) when attempting to review the PKGBUILD during the full file audit, resulting in an 'inconclusive' verdict. The deepseek model successfully reviewed the same file and found it safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review the PKGBUILD during the full file audit due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for LLM API errors (like HTTP 400) during file reviews to prevent transient API issues from forcing an inconclusive package verdict.
Ensure the audit pipeline can aggregate partial results or recognize when a critical file like PKGBUILD has been successfully vetted by another model in a parallel run.
